python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Original interest-bearing debt outstanding (series E and EE, calendar years, in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# CPI-U annual average (BLS official)
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
# Formula: adjusted = original * (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adjusted_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adjusted_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adjusted_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # = debt_1994 since denominator is same

print("Inflation-adjusted values in constant 1994 dollars:")
print(f"1992: {adjusted_1992:.2f} million")
print(f"1993: {adjusted_1993:.2f} million")
print(f"1994: {adjusted_1994:.2f} million")

# Calculate sample mean
values = [adjusted_1992, adjusted_1993, adjusted_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1)
squared_diffs = [(v - mean)**2 for v in values]
sample_variance = sum(squared_diffs) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f"Sample Std Dev (n-1): {sample_std:.2f}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score_1994 = (adjusted_1994 - mean) / sample_std
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score_1994:.2f}")
print(f"Z-score rounded to 2 decimals: {round(z_score_1994, 2)}")
EOF
